title: Craft (ability)
description: A craft. THE CLOSED SCHEMA — additionalProperties:false, so a field must be DECLARED HERE before it can be authored.
_doNotRegenerate: ⛔ THIS FILE IS AUTHORED, NOT GENERATED. It was bootstrapped once from the corpus on 2026-08-28 and is hand-maintained from here. ⚠️ REGENERATING IT WOULD RUBBER-STAMP WHATEVER FIELDS HAPPEN TO EXIST, which defeats its entire purpose: the point is that adding a field is a DELIBERATE ACT SOMEBODY REVIEWS. To add one, edit this file first, then author the content.
_notesAreLegal: ⚠️ Any key beginning with `_` is accepted anywhere, unvalidated. Authors carry their reasoning inline (98 at the craft root alone) and a schema that forbade that would make people delete their own thinking.
_darkFields: ⛔ Properties described as DARK are authored and have NO LITERAL READER. They are legal because they exist, not because they work. See docs/FIELD_REFERENCE.md §6 for a diagnosis of each before deleting any of them.
_gatedBy: tests/content_ci.mjs — CCODE-288, which also proves the closed-set check can go RED.

damageMix.description: ⛔ A COMPOSITE BLOW — the craft deals several damage types at once, and a ward answers only the parts it answers. Read by `damageMixOf` in engine/damagetypes.js, which normalises the shares to 1. ⚠️ DECLARED 2026-08-29: the READER shipped with CCODE-281 and the SCHEMA never learned the field, so the first craft to author one (`ki_wield`) was rejected by the closed schema. A reader with no schema entry — the four-doors failure at the AUTHORED door. ⛔ USE THIS INSTEAD OF `damageType` when the fiction names more than one kind of harm: a ki bolt is `force` and `physical`, and armour answers only the second.
